title: Cypress fails to parse environment variables with empty values

labels.name: pkg/server
labels.description: This is due to an issue in the packages/server directory

body:
### Current behavior:

Cypress fails to parse command line environment variables when environment variables with empty values are supplied.

### Desired behavior:

Should default to setting the values to `undefined`

### Steps to reproduce: (app code and test code)

Run a command like `cypress run --env="USERNAME=,PASSWORD="`

### Versions

3.2.0 and earlier
